name: Arugula Salad with Pork, Butternut Squash, Pears, Goat Cheese & Trail Mix (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the arugula if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small butternut squash
1 (5 oz) pkg baby arugula

instructions.primary_message: Trim and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Place in a medium bowl along with oil, sugar, and spices, then stir to coat. Transfer squash to a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer. (Reserve bowl for the salad.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp brown sugar
⅛ tsp cinnamon, ground
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway, until squash is fork-tender and golden, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pork chops, boneless
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
While the pork chops are cooking, place additional oil, vinegar, Dijon, and spices in the reserved bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp apple cider vinegar
1 tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter, core, and thinly slice pears. Add half to the bowl with the dressing, then set remaining pear aside for the kid plates.
Place pecans, cranberries, and pumpkin seeds in a small bowl. Stir to combine the "trail mix," then add half to the bowl with the dressing. Set remaining trail mix aside for the kid plates.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup pecan halves
⅓ cup dried cranberries
¼ cup pumpkin seeds

instructions.primary_message: When the squash is done, add half to the bowl, along with arugula, and toss to combine the salad. (Reserve remaining squash for the kid plates.)
Medium dice one pork chop, then thinly slice remaining pork chops.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide reserved roasted squash, pear, trail mix, and diced pork between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide salad and sliced pork between plates. Crumble goat cheese over the salad and enjoy!
